owner: Codex in James-approved Peninsula Insider page-quality programme

baseline.source: Three independent exact-live rubric reviews at 320/390/1440 after batch13 release. Full score null. Reviewers found a timed newsletter dialog interrupting first-visit map/nearby reading while cookie consent was undecided, an additional sticky subscribe pill after dismissal, three nearby cards using placeholder or CMS media without item-level subject/rights proof, a five-item list titled four lines, no direct Council reserve-access link, and a heavy hero JPEG.
baseline.mobilePerformance: Independent Chrome 390x844 lab with 4x CPU, 150ms latency and 1.6 Mb/s measured hero LCP 9.69-10.16s; original JPEG 615757 bytes transferred over about 9.6s. Lab sample, not field data.

hypothesis: A source-linked reserve action, responsive licensed image, verified-media-only nearby treatment and uninterrupted reading reduce mobile task friction and remove the currently uncertain nearby-card imagery.
boundedChange: On place guide pages, omit the timed newsletter popup and sticky subscribe pill while retaining the footer Dispatch link; globally prevent the popup from overtaking an undecided cookie prompt. On Tootgarook only, render its three nearby places as designed text cards without any CMS-swappable image; correct the numbered heading; add a direct Council access link; deliver the same Commons photograph as 480/960/1440 WebP derivatives with visible conversion disclosure. No change to booking, filtering, cookie consent, image source or other place heroes.
metric: At 320/390/1440 the Council link works, all five summary points are correctly labelled, no newsletter modal or pill interrupts Tootgarook, three nearby cards have no image/CMS slot, footer signup remains, all content fits with no overflow or page errors. At 390 the selected hero derivative is at most 960px and under 100 KB; rerun the same 4x CPU/1.6 Mb/s lab and compare LCP with 9.69-10.16s baseline. Full build, CI and exact live manifest/browser acceptance required.
rollback: Restore place-page promo rendering and the original image/nearby-card presentation if measured outcomes regress; retain the copyright attribution and original Commons source file.
